j:translation_en.jcr:title: GraphQL Extension Websites administrator
j:translation_en.jcr:description: Grants access to the website lifecycle GraphQL mutations (create, export, import) without requiring full server administrator rights. Does NOT grant site deletion: to delegate deletion of a specific site, grant the 'GraphQL Extension Websites site administrator' role on that site. To delegate a narrower subset, build a custom role from the individual websitesCreate / websitesExport / websitesExportAll permissions instead of granting this one.

j:translation_en.jcr:title: GraphQL Extension Websites site administrator
j:translation_en.jcr:description: Grants deletion of the site this role is granted on, through the deleteSiteByKey GraphQL mutation. Grant it per site; the holder also needs the server-level 'GraphQL Extension Websites administrator' role to reach the API.
